name: Glarus
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Glarus
summary: A red square with Saint Fridolin, an Irish missionary monk, walking with a staff and a book. It is the only Swiss cantonal flag showing a person.
origin: Saint Fridolin, who is said to have founded the abbey of Säckingen in the 6th century, is the patron of Glarus. The canton joined the Confederacy in 1352.

symbols.name: Saint Fridolin
symbols.description: A pilgrim monk with a staff and a Bible.

facts: It is the only Swiss cantonal flag with a human figure.
Glarus is famous for its open-air assembly, the Landsgemeinde.
clues: A walking monk with a staff on red.
The only Swiss cantonal flag showing a person.
Its figure is an Irish missionary saint.
